welcome.text: This is a guide to the market dashboard: where a coordinator sets up market day, steers registration and the lottery, and keeps the records.

tabs.text: Open the admin dashboard on your phone and sign in. Along the top is a row of screens. Swipe it to reach the rest.

schedule.text: Market days come from the Schedule. The recurring pattern sets when registration opens each week, how long it stays open, and how many places there are.

upcoming.text: Below it is the next session the pattern created. When a session ends, the next one is created automatically.

oneOff.text: For a special market, Add one-off schedules a single session in place of the next one.

current.text: Current session follows today’s market step by step. The badge at the top always says where it stands.

scheduled.text: Registration opens on its own at the scheduled time. Open Early starts it now, and Postpone pushes it back.

open.text: At ten thirty, registration opens, and guests start signing up from their own phones.

registered.text: Each guest appears under Registered as they join, with their household size, language, and phone number.

overrides.text: If guests need more time, extend registration by a few minutes. You can also change the queue capacity: how many places the lottery fills.

closeEarly.text: Registration closes on its own when the window ends. Close early ends it now, once you confirm.

grace.text: After registration closes, a short grace period lets anyone still submitting finish. Then the lottery is pending.

pending.text: It draws automatically at the time the schedule sets. Run immediately draws it now, and you can postpone it a few minutes, or pause the automatic draw.

draw.text: When the lottery runs, every guest sees their result on their phone, and service starts.

overview.text: During service, Today’s overview counts guests as they are served, called, and still waiting.

queue.text: Go to Queue opens the line itself. Calling guests up is covered in the queue desk guide.

addGuest.text: Someone who could not register can still be helped. Add guest takes their details, just as the guest form does.

admission.text: During service, Give them a spot puts them straight into the line, using one of the session’s places.

saveGuest.text: Save guest, and they join the end of the line.

broadcast.text: To reach everyone at once, Broadcast notification sends a message to every guest in today’s session who signed up for updates.

message.text: Write a short title and message. It goes out exactly as written, so check it before you send.

database.text: Guest database holds everyone on record. Search by name or phone number to find someone.

history.text: Session history lists past markets, and you can still add a guest to one after the fact.

reports.text: Reports count people without naming them: sign-ups, guests served, and how full each session ran.

close.text: When nobody is left to call, Close session takes the place of Call next. Closing sooner, from the Session actions menu, marks anyone still waiting as a no show.

next.text: The day moves to Session history, and the schedule’s next market is ready, a week away.

thanks.text: That’s the market dashboard. Thank you for running the market.
